entities.name: DoxaBrowserExtensionBankingGates
observations: doxa-browser-extension had NO CI, NO .knowledge-graph/ and NO .claude/hooks/ while taking autonomous work: PRs #2-#9 all landed on 2026-08-15 completely unbanked and ungated, the only active Doxa repo in that state. Installed the standard banking kit ported from doxa-discord-bot: .github/workflows/kg-guard.yml (job explicitly named 'KG Guard' so a branch ruleset can require it by name rather than the ambiguous bare job id 'check'), scripts/knowledge-graph-merkle.cjs + kg-index.cjs + check-kg-merge-integrity.cjs + lib/, scripts/attest-review.sh, and .claude/hooks/{kg-save-gate,review-gate,test-gate,session-start-kg-import,pre-compact-kg-export}.sh wired through .claude/settings.json. .cjs not .js because this package is type=module. test-gate patterns retargeted to this repo's real layout (src/**.ts sources, test/*.test.mjs run by node --test).

Independent review (high) on PR #10 found the ported kit shipped several gates that report without gating. Fixed here: (1) kg-save-gate.sh replaced with doxa-cns's evolved version, which carries the kg_guard_verdict CI oracle (2026-08-11 rule: a merge with a red or PENDING KG Guard never lands) -- the discord-bot variant had no such fast path, so a red KG Guard blocked nothing. (2) review-gate.sh: when the PR's real remote head SHA resolves it is now the ONLY attestation candidate; OR-ing it into local worktree tips could only widen the pass set, and was verified admitting 'gh pr merge 9' on the strength of an unrelated attested local tip. (3) repo_slug_of(): 'gh repo view $dir' is an argument error (gh wants OWNER/REPO, never a path) and always failed, silently disabling the PR-file-list lookups both gates rely on; the slug now comes from the checkout's origin remote. (4) test-gate code_re widened from ^src/ to ^(src|scripts)/ -- scripts/copy-static.mjs performs the import rewrite the shipped extension depends on and was ungated; and its block message now names test/ (what npm test actually runs) instead of a tests/ directory that does not exist here. (5) check-kg-merge-integrity is invoked as .cjs, not .js: the [ -f ] guard was false so the PR #343 data-loss guard was inert -- the same silently-inert-gate class the rest of this PR is about. Vendored scripts/*.test.cjs added and wired into npm test: 30/30 pass. NOT fixed here, and live in the sibling repos this kit came from (doxa-discord-bot, doxa-mcp-schema, scripture-grounding-mcp, doxa-shared): test-gate.sh's worktree loop over-blocks on unrelated stale worktrees, and knowledge-graph-merkle's 'add' exits 0 on a usage error so a scripted kg-save can read as success while writing nothing.

entities.name: DoxaForChromeExtension
observations: Retrospective backfill of PRs #1-#9 and the repo scaffold, all of which landed on 2026-08-14/15 BEFORE this repo had any KG, CI or hooks — the pre-gate history the banking detector surfaced. What actually shipped: #1 DoxaBot extension v0.2.0 (per-caller quota, tests, hardened build); #2 the Chrome Web Store publish package; #3 rename to 'Doxa for Chrome' with subscription framing, replacing the DoxaBot identity; #4 the master line 'Know the God who speaks' applied across every extension surface, per the yada messaging pivot; #5 Doxa sign-in plus a subscription gate, with BYOL (bring-your-own-licence) REMOVED — the extension no longer accepts a user-supplied key, so entitlement is server-side; #6 and #8 pinned the extension id by fixing the manifest key to the Chrome Web Store id, which is what keeps the published listing and local builds on one identity; #7 recorded the publish package as READY with the gate deployed; #9 rewrote the store listing copy to lead with the knowing-God promise. Banked retrospectively rather than left as a permanent gap: the work is real and this is the only record of WHY the extension's identity, entitlement model and listing copy are what they are.

v0.3.0 (PR #13): three changes — (1) CTA copy Know the God who speaks replaced with Engage Scripture with Doxa across all surfaces: manifest description, popup.html, options.html, store/listing.md, all 4 store/assets-src templates, package.json description. (2) Selection bubble content script (see SelectionBubbleContentScript). (3) Side panel chat (see DoxaEngageSidePanel). Background.ts rewritten with encourageAndRoute() routing to side panel or toast fallback via isSidePanelOpen(). New permissions: sidePanel + all_urls (content script). Version bumped to 0.3.0. Extension NOT yet published to Chrome Web Store. 30/30 tests pass.

entities.name: SelectionBubbleContentScript
observations: v0.3.0 (PR #13): content script src/content/selection-bubble.ts injected on all pages via manifest content_scripts + <all_urls> host_permissions. On mouseup, if selection >= 3 chars and NOT in an editable target (textarea/input/contenteditable), shows a 32x32px Doxa flame bubble 8px above selection end (or below near viewport top). Shadow DOM isolation (doxa-bubble-host, separate from doxa-toast-host) prevents CSS conflicts. Dismissed on mousedown/scroll/click-outside/8s-timeout/selection-cleared. On click sends chrome.runtime.sendMessage({action: encourage-selection, text}) to background. Self-contained, no ES module imports. The Mac-smooth alternative to right-click context menus.

entities.name: DoxaEngageSidePanel
observations: v0.3.0 (PR #13): Chrome Side Panel API (chrome.sidePanel) for persistent Doxa Engage chat alongside browsing. Files: static/sidepanel.html + sidepanel.css, src/sidepanel.ts. openPanelOnActionClick:true makes toolbar icon toggle the side panel (primary surface; popup demoted to right-click). Multi-turn sessions simulated client-side: composeSituation() builds context from last 3 exchange pairs within 2000-char limit for the single-turn MCP doxa_encourage tool. Session persistence via chrome.storage.local keyed by session ID. Listens for chrome.runtime.onMessage action:encourage-in-panel from background (selection bubble route). ENGAGE button outline-only (transparent bg, FF4500 border+text). Dark theme. New Session button clears thread.
